content.value_statement: Creating Claude Code skills requires accurate triggers, safe hooks, and clear documentation. This guide gives templates, patterns, and troubleshooting steps for reliable skill activation.
actual_capabilities: Explains Claude Code skill file structure, frontmatter, naming, and the 500-line documentation rule.
Shows how to configure skill-rules.json with keywords, intent regex, file paths, and content patterns.
Documents UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, and Stop hook behavior for suggestions, blocks, and reminders.
Provides testing commands for hook activation, JSON validation, and trigger debugging.
Lists skip conditions, session tracking, and fixes for false positives.
limitations: It is documentation only; it does not install hooks or create skills automatically.
Shell commands are examples and require user review before use.
Patterns must be adapted to each project to avoid false positives.
It focuses on Claude Code skill workflows, not general plugin packaging.

use_cases.title: Create a New Skill
use_cases.description: Draft a Claude Code skill with frontmatter, trigger rules, references, and a testing checklist.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Guardrails
use_cases.description: Define when hooks should suggest, warn, or block work across a shared project.

use_cases.title: Debug Skill Activation
use_cases.description: Find why a skill does not trigger, blocks too often, or ignores expected files.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Claude Code skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill-developer guide to draft a Claude Code skill for [topic]. Include frontmatter, trigger keywords, and a testing checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Activation Triggers
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve matching accuracy for an existing skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned skill triggers for [skill name]. Suggest safer keywords, intent patterns, file paths, and exclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Debug Hook Behavior
prompt_templates.scenario: Find why a hook suggestion or block is not working.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me troubleshoot a Claude Code hook that should activate [skill name] when [condition]. Walk through likely causes and checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Guardrail Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a guardrail plan for [project area]. Decide which skills should suggest, warn, or block, and explain the tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for database schema verification.
output: A skill outline with purpose, trigger terms, reference files, and a validation checklist.
Suggested guardrail behavior for database files and migration workflows.
Testing steps for prompt matching, file matching, and false positive review.

output_examples.input: My skill does not trigger for frontend component work.
output: A troubleshooting path for keywords, intent patterns, file paths, and hook registration.
Likely pattern changes that make activation more specific and reliable.
Manual checks for hook output and session state.

output_examples.input: Plan team guardrails for risky edits.
output: A suggested split between advisory skills and blocking guardrails.
Guidance on block messages, skip conditions, and session tracking.
A review checklist for rollout safety and developer friction.

best_practices: Keep SKILL.md under 500 lines and move deep details into first-level reference files.
Test keywords, intent patterns, file paths, and content patterns with real prompts and files.
Use blocking guardrails only for high-impact mistakes and provide clear block messages.
anti_patterns: Using broad keywords such as system, work, or create as standalone triggers.
Adding skip markers or environment overrides as routine workflow shortcuts.
Embedding large reference material directly in SKILL.md when progressive disclosure would be clearer.

faq.question: Does this skill create files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation, templates, and testing guidance for creating Claude Code skills manually.

faq.question: Which Claude Code hooks does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, and Stop hook behavior for suggestions, blocking checks, and reminders.

faq.question: Can it help reduce false positives?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains specific trigger design, exclusions, testing, and troubleshooting methods for noisy activations.

faq.question: Does it include ready-to-use trigger patterns?
faq.answer: Yes. Reference files include common keyword, regex, file path, and content pattern examples.

faq.question: Is it only for guardrail skills?
faq.answer: No. It covers both advisory domain skills and blocking guardrail skills.

faq.question: What should teams review before using it?
faq.answer: Teams should review hook commands, skip controls, and enforcement levels before applying patterns in a project.
